title: Number of Subarrays With GCD Equal to K
summary: Given an integer array and a target integer, count the subarrays where the greatest common divisor of the elements equals the target integer.
statement: Given an integer array and a target integer, count the subarrays where the greatest common divisor of the elements equals the target integer. A subarray consists of consecutive elements, and the greatest common divisor of an array is the largest integer dividing all elements without a remainder.
constraints: A subarray is a nonempty contiguous segment.
Compute the greatest common divisor of every segment’s values.
Return how many subarrays have GCD exactly k.
hints: Track counts of each GCD among subarrays ending at the previous index.
Start a new one-element subarray, then append the current value to every prior ending subarray and merge equal resulting GCDs.
Add the count stored under k.
Every subarray ending here is either the singleton or uniquely extends one ending previously, so all and only qualifying segments are counted.
editorial: Every subarray ending here is either the singleton or uniquely extends one ending previously, so all and only qualifying segments are counted.
